children: Iberdrola SA (BME:IBE) invested €10.1 billion in nine months, up 13% year over year, as net profit rose 9.6% to €5.8 billion; it now targets at least 10% adjusted profit growth in 2026. The company also added a 274 MW wind farm in Portugal to its Iberian renewables platform with Norges Bank.
: Iberdrola invested €10.1 billion in nine months, up 13% year over year; net profit rose 9.6% to €5.8 billion. It now targets at least 10% adjusted profit growth in 2026.
: Iberdrola and Norges Bank added the 274 MW Tâmega wind farm in Portugal to their €2 billion Iberian renewables platform. Portfolio capacity tops 1,800 MW, with 2,300 MW expected next year.
: Iberdrola (IBE), via Avangrid, plans to upgrade over 230 New York transmission lines covering 1,300 km. Work runs through 2031 to boost grid reliability and meet future power demand.
: Iberdrola, through Neoenergia, agreed to sell its remaining stake in Brazil’s Dardanelos hydro plant to Itaú-managed funds, completing its exit pending regulatory approvals.
: Iberdrola’s partnership added Spain’s Caparacena and Ciudad Rodrigo solar plants, totaling 646 MW. The alliance aims to reach 2,300 MW of renewable capacity by 2027.
: Iberdrola (IBE) is selling eight district-heating projects in Castilla y León and Madrid, seeking €50 million to €100 million. Deloitte is advising; Iberdrola is expected to keep managing them.
